dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave spline fitting between the posterior base and the sub-apical region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a medium pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual convex slope measured at approximately 30 to 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide-based silhouette with an estimated 1.7:1 ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular notch is visible on the trailing edge approximately one-third of the distance from the posterior base to the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive specular highlights and high-contrast glint patterns are visible across the lower anterior portion of the dorsal fin and adjacent back region.
